messages.content: 紐約目前的交通狀況如何？

function.name: geocode_address
function.description: Transforms a description of a location (like a pair of coordinates, an address, or a name of a place) to a location on the Earth's surface. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

address.description: The address that needs to be geocoded.

locale.description: Preferred locale for the returned address information. (Optional) Default: None

message.content: 抱歉，我目前無法取得即時的交通資訊。若您需要紐約市的地理座標（經緯度）或其他地址相關資料，我可以協助進行地理編碼。請告訴我您想要查詢的具體地址或位置名稱，我將為您提供相對應的座標資訊。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "紐約目前的交通狀況如何？" which means "What is the current traffic situation in New York?" We need to provide real-time traffic data. We have a tool geocode_address but not a traffic tool. We might need to use geocode_address to get coordinates for New York, then maybe we can use some other API? But only geocode_address is available. There's no traffic tool. So we cannot provide real-time traffic. We should explain that we can't fetch real-time traffic. We can geocode the address "New York" to get coordinates. But that doesn't give traffic. We could say we can get coordinates but not traffic. The user wants traffic. We can respond that we don't have real-time traffic data. We can offer to get coordinates. But the user didn't ask for coordinates. We can politely say we can't provide real-time traffic.
